# REDTEAM #106 (SPEC Sec 8.3, T-301.1; IMPLEMENTATION.md M18-S3):
# runtime.SetFinalizer on an arena object MUST panic with
# "runtime: SetFinalizer on loGo/s arena object", for both the noscan
# and scan regions, while heap and fallback objects remain valid. A
# .lgo-level probe cannot reach an arena address: any pointer flowing
# into SetFinalizer escapes to the heap by construction (escape analysis
# tracks even uintptr-laundered round trips as foreign conversions), so
# the make always lands on the heap and the guard never fires. This
# script gates the focused unit test instead, which reaches both regions
# directly through the test-only arena seam and also pins the heap and
# mallocgc-fallback controls.

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosarena
go test -count=1 -run 'TestLogosArenaSetFinalizerPanics$' runtime
go test -race -count=1 -run 'TestLogosArenaSetFinalizerPanics$' runtime

-- go.mod --
module example.com/redteam106

go 1.27
